facts.fact: Decree 2.26.576 of 3 August 2026 authorises Tamwilcom to take stakes for the Fonds Catalytique Startups in funds investing in startups, capped at 347 million dirhams over three years, under the Digital Morocco 2030 strategy.

note: No startups labelled and no investment made is stated; nine fund managers are only pre-selected.
